liner.body_md:
## The recordings

- **gd1981-03-04.142326.reckoning.sbd.miller.flac2496** (recommended): soundboard; 16 songs; 77 min; rated 1.2/5 by 5 [1]. Said about its sound: Good-quality soundboard with an audience clearly audible, though the reviewer says it dates from the previous fall; More audience between songs than the released album, and the mix differs somewhat from the final LP [4][5]
- **gd1981-03-04.142485.ReckoningOuttakes.cm.miller.flac1644**: source not stated; 16 songs; 77 min [2]
- **gd1981-03-04.142330.reckoning-gdmix.flac1644**: source not stated; 16 songs; 78 min [3]. Said about its sound: More audience between songs than the released album, and the mix differs somewhat from the final LP [3]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says the date is mislabeled: the band played Cleveland on March 2 and 3, then Pittsburgh on the 5th and 6th [4]
- The band was on the road on March 4, 1981; the date may mark the end of the editing work [7]
- The band played Cleveland on March 2 and 3, 1981, and the Stanley Theater in Pittsburgh on March 5 and 6 [8]
- Several cuts match the Reckoning release, recognizable by distinctive vocal comments in Monkey And The Engineer and Ripple [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1981-03-04.142326.reckoning.sbd.miller.flac2496**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Master Production Disc > Cassette Master (TDK MA90) [1]. Also: Purportedly the band's Club Front mix, submitted to Arista for the 1981 Reckoning LP; Fifteen tracks came out on one CD in 1988, omitting Oh Babe, It Ain't No Lie; expanded double CD followed in 2006; Reviewer claims Reckoning was copied to the Archive and passed off as a Charlie Miller recording of a nonexistent show [5][6][7]
- **gd1981-03-04.142485.ReckoningOuttakes.cm.miller.flac1644**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Master Production Disc > Cassette Master (TDK MA90) [2]. Also: This file set is 16 bit at 44.1 and labeled as Reckoning outtakes [2]
- **gd1981-03-04.142330.reckoning-gdmix.flac1644**: source: Lineage: The tape was labelled "2nd generation off master", taken to mean MSR or MSC > Cass1 > Cass2; [3]. Also: Purportedly the band's Club Front mix, submitted to Arista for the 1981 Reckoning LP; Fifteen tracks came out on one CD in 1988, omitting Oh Babe, It Ain't No Lie; expanded double CD followed in 2006 [3]
